final_message:
Declined payments are now retried, and a subscription recovers or moves to `unpaid` as intended. The full suite passes (26 tests).

**Root cause:** `due_for_retry` in `billing/dunning.py` filtered invoices on `invoice["status"] == "opened"`. Invoice statuses are `"open"` (see `InvoiceStatus` in `billing/models.py`, and every other check in the codebase uses `"open"`). So the filter never matched, and no failed invoice was ever picked up for retry. The invoice kept its past `next_attempt_at`, and the subscription stayed `past_due`.

**Fix:** changed the comparison to `"open"` in `billing/dunning.py`.

**Tests:** added `tests/test_dunning_retry.py` with two cases:
- A declined renewal is retried on schedule, the invoice is paid, and the subscription returns to `active`.
- Four consecutive declines (the full retry schedule) move the subscription to `unpaid`.

Both fail on the original code and pass with the fix.

**`answer.json`** is written at the repo root with `{"file": "dunning.py", "function": "due_for_retry"}`. It is not shown in `git status`, so it's presumably covered by `.gitignore`.

I haven't committed anything.

steps.command: grep -rn "\"open\"\|\"opened\"\|InvoiceStatus\|due_for_retry\|record_failure" billing tests && sed -n 1,60p billing/models.py | grep -n "Status"
cat tests/conftest.py | head -80 && grep -n "decline\|fail\|advance" tests/test_lifecycle.py | head -20 && grep -n "def \|fail" billing/gateway.py | head -30
sed -n 1,40p tests/test_lifecycle.py && grep -n "def create_subscription\|def create_\|def subscribe" billing/subscriptions.py && grep -n "DECLINE_CODES" -A4 billing/gateway.py | head -8

cat > tests/test_dunning_retry.py <<'EOF'
from billing import ledger  # noqa: F401  (keeps parity with other lifecycle tests)


def test_declined_renewal_is_retried_and_recovers(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    world.gateway.fail_next = ["card_declined"]
    world.advance_days(31)
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
    [failed] = [inv for inv in world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"]) if inv["status"] == "open"]
    assert failed["next_attempt_at"] is not None

    world.advance_days(1)
    assert sub["status"] == "active"
    assert failed["status"] == "paid"
    assert failed["next_attempt_at"] is None


def test_repeated_declines_escalate_to_unpaid(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    world.gateway.fail_next = ["card_declined"] * 4
    world.advance_days(31)
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
    world.advance_days(1)
    world.advance_days(3)
    world.advance_days(7)
    assert sub["status"] == "unpaid"
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30; git stash -q && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_dunning_retry.py 2>&1 | tail -3; git stash pop -q && git status --short

sed -i '' '1,2d' tests/test_dunning_retry.py && head -3 tests/test_dunning_retry.py && printf '{"file": "dunning.py", "function": "due_for_retry"}\n' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2 && git status --short
